Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing record checks for developmental disabilities service providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to record checks for developmental disabilitiesservice providers; and adding a new section to chapter 71A.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71A.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All persons who provide services under this chapter and who willhave regularly scheduled unsupervised access to persons withdevelopmental disabilities are required to submit to a record checkthrough the Washington state patrol criminal identification systemunder RCW 43.43.830 through 43.43.834, 10.97.030, and 10.97.050, andthrough the federal bureau of investigation. The record check shallinclude a fingerprint check using a complete Washington state criminalidentification fingerprint card. The requesting entity shall providea copy of the record report to the applicant. When necessary, personsmay be employed on a conditional basis pending completion of theinvestigation. If the applicant has had a record check within theprevious two years, the agency may waive the requirement.
